title: Workshop Production Run: 3,500 cr, 25 crafting XP and 20 Piloting XP; accepted at Node Beta, five steel plates smelted there from the pilot's own stored iron, handed in there
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-17 12:00 UTC (rule F34: crafting missions are Logistics'; orders.log ENT-036, task 2). The board of Node Beta Industrial Station offers it (data/missions, read 11:54 UTC), and Central Nexus too: one objective, craft_item, 'Craft 5 items using any recipe', quantity 5; rewards 3,500 cr, crafting 25 XP, piloting 20 XP. The route maker lists it as lacking a craft_item step; the circuit runner's craft step already crafts at the workshop, so the route accepts at stop 1, crafts 5 runs of basic_iron_smelting (10 iron ore make 1 steel plate, 0 cr, by hand) at stop 2, and hands in at stop 3, all at Node Beta. Nothing is bought. requires.stored sends only a pilot that stores 60 iron ore there (most haulers store 500 or more). A test: one ship until its first RESULT line is read (rule F12); whether the board offers it again to a pilot that handed it in is not known: read the board after the hand-in. First RESULT line 2026-11-17 12:41 UTC: 3 of 3 stops in 6.9 minutes, +3,448 cr, 3,500 cr paid once (Workshop Production Run). Lifted to 4 ships and put into the hauler plan's list First at 2026-11-17 16:00 UTC (Apollo): every hauler that stores 60 iron ore at Node Beta flies it once.
